pr_title: ADR0133: complete Remote AI Studio first-release validation
pr_body:
## Summary

Completes ADR0133 Remote AI Studio first-release validation from current main. Adds deterministic host-owned Remote state and actual Microsoft Edge capture of the production loopback companion at desktop, narrow, and mobile widths. The Remote helper uses an explicit ADR0133 visual scenario, is excluded from native screenshot auto-close, and normalizes/isolates inherited visual environment.

## Validation

Requires full Windows Validation because `scripts/ci/**` changes, Automation Regression, and ChatGPT visual review of the production Remote AI Studio screenshots.
